name: MentorMatchingManager
tagline: Score, match and support mentoring relationships – from waiting list to successful closure.
description: A complete mentoring programme app in one Power Apps component: mentor and mentee profiles, a matchmaker that ranks mentors on interests, language, site, availability, gender preference and age with safeguarding blocks, a match lifecycle board with agreements and structured closure, check-ins with match health, mentor screening and waiting-time and capacity KPIs. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Safeguarding blocks: screening, training, capacity, adult mentor, gender preference, shared language
Match lifecycle Waiting → Proposed → Active → On hold → Closing → Closed
Signed agreement and safeguarding briefing before a match starts
Check-ins with health 1–5, concerns and at-risk flags
Waiting-time, capacity, retention and early-closure KPIs
Bulk coordinator / export, undo, audit history
Demo mode with 22 mentors and 34 mentees
